text.title: Общая информация
lines: Operations are missions where a Task Force attempts to destroy a Blackguard by targeting its bases.
Each Operation lasts 23 hours and 55 minutes and will only end after the timer expires.

When the Operation ends, each eligible player in the Task Force receives an Operation Reward that depends on the Task Force's performance during the Operation. Aside from the number of Force Points won by the Task Force, the reward also scales depending on the player's Headquarters level and the Task Force's maximum possible size.
The Task Force will also receive Force Points once the Operation ends.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Unlike the Daily Victory Point Reward, Power Stones and Prototype Modules are always excluded. This is because Supercell did not want being in a Task Force to be required to compete on the solo Leaderboards.
The factories are powered by Power Stones that the Blackguard have been stealing from the Native Islanders after destroying their villages.

Each Operation actually lasts 23 hours and 55 minutes, despite being stated in-game as 24 hours. Therefore, starting an operation within 5 minutes from the daily reset can allow another operation to be started before the daily reset the next day, basically allowing 2 operations to be completed in 1 reset period.

Operations originally truly lasted 24 hours and Forlorn Hope and Duplexity (the most difficult Operations) were introduced later, making 32,000 FP the original maximum amount of Force Points a Task Force could have. Current maximum is 43,200 FP (without double Operation), or 45,360 FP (with double Operation, but only for at most 5 minutes).

The reason for the change was to allow Task Forces to always start Operations at the same time of day, as with a 24 hour long Operation the Task Force would be forced to always start a bit later every day. Even if an attack begins at the last possible second and lasts the full 4 minutes and 40 seconds.

As the FP are always rounded up, it is in fact possible to stabilize them at 43,219 once a double mission has already been completed once, and do another double mission to push the limit to 45,379 FP.

If you spectate an attack, Smoke Screens and Flares that have taken effect before you started to spectate will not be visible. However, the troops appear to be covered as if it were there and the timers will appear as well.
If the attack has been going on for some time, the replay will speed up to the point where it is live.

Players who are disconnected from the game during their attack who log back into the game during a live attack will not be connected back to their attack. Instead, to their account, the attack will have been completed and registered, even if other players are still spectating the attack in real time.

There are three levels of "Co-Operator" achievements which awards every Task Force member 10, 20, and 30 diamonds upon gaining 100, 400, and 800 Force Points from a single operation, respectively. To earn the 10, 20, and 30 diamond awards a Task Force needs to complete Operation Full Monty, Powder Keg, and Stronghold, respectively.
Note: Completing the operation is not required; the Task Force must simply collect the aforementioned number of Force Points during an operation.

For example, a group of high-level players who have never operated within a task force could conceivably be awarded all 60 diamonds from a single operation by attaining 815 out of the 990 Force Points available from Operation Choke Point.
Most power bases have no trees or stones in them. However, there are bases with a Mangrove Thicket in it.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Task Forces are collaborative groups of players.
You must have at least a level 6 Headquarters to create a Task Force.

You can join a Task Force without having a level 6 or higher Headquarters, but you must be invited to the Task Force through the Friends List. In order to be invited, the invitor must be a rank holder (officer, co-leader, or leader) in the Task Force.
Users in a Task Force can chat with each other.
Players in a Task Force collect Intel which is used to go on Operations in the Blackguard Mainland.
In Operations started by a rank holder in the Task Force, the players in the Task Force work together to take down Blackguard Factories and earn Force Points and Operation Rewards.
A player can only be in one Task Force at a time.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Players in a Task Force can chat through the chat window which is accessed through the button below the Diamond counter. Shared replays can also be viewed from this window. Note: This button, along with the Operation button, will not appear if you are not in a Task Force.

On a Task Force's info screen, you can view basic information about it as well as a list of its members which shows each player's name, XP level, Victory Point count, rank (discussed below), and the amount of Intel collected that week.
Once you are in a Task Force, you will begin earning Intel which allows the Task Force to start Operations.

Rank holding players can invite other players to join their Task Force by using the Friends list. Note that being invited is the only way to join a Task Force without having the required Victory Points or requesting to join Task Forces with that option enabled.
Learn more about Intel, Operations, and Operation Rewards on their pages.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Friends who have not yet upgraded their Headquarters to level 6 are not technically barred from entering Task Forces. They are still able to be sent invites through the Friends List and can enter without the upgrade.

Every Task Force has a unique tag which can be entered into the Task Force search to find that specific Task Force, even if the Task Force has no standing membership. This makes it easier to find a certain Task Force especially if several Task Forces have that same name.
You cannot change the name of a Task Force once you have created it.
There are 3,360 unique ways to customize your Task Force's logo.
If a player's request to join is rejected or they are kicked, they can re-request or rejoin after 24 hours.

Players in your Task Force cannot appear on your Archipelago as opponents. If they appear on your map, the invasion is immediately lost, but not necessarily replaced immediately. If someone on your Archipelago joins your Task Force, then that recruit is lost from your map immediately with no guaranteed replacement.

The leader can promote a co-leader, making him/her the leader instead while the former leader will automitically be demoted to co-leader. However, by doing so, the new leader has supreme control over the former leader.
If the leader leaves the clan without promoting another co-leader, leadership will automatically transfer to the most senior member of the highest rank.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Intel is a resource vital to Task Force Operations.
It is only possible to earn Intel while in a Task Force. However, once collected, it stays with said Task Force, whose capacity is determined by its maximum size.
10 members = 900
25 members = 1400
50 members = 2300
Once a certain amount of Intel has been collected, the Task Force leader or officers can spend Intel to begin an Operation. See the Operation article for further details.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Intel's icon appears to be a blueprint for the Power Core on Blackguard factories.
Collecting Intel from the destruction of a base yields the same SFX that is heard when two Victory Points are earned from a Blackguard Base. If Power Stones also spawn, it may be overridden.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Force Points measure how effective your Task Force is in the war against the Blackguard.
A Task Force wins one Force Point for every building that it destroys in an Operation.
The Task Force Leaderboards are based on Force Point totals. A higher Force Point total puts a Task Force higher on its Leaderboard.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: The maximum amount of Force Points that you can get from an Operation is shown below its title on the Operation map. To get this amount, your Task Force would have to completely destroy all of the power bases in that Operation.
See the Operation page to find out how many Force Points that each Operation can award.

Destroying the Power Core on a power base will set off a chain reaction that destroys any remaining Buildings on the power base which rewards you with the all of the Force Points possible for that power base.
You do not have to destroy an entire power base to receive Force Points from it. Even destroying just one building will give you one Force Point.
Your Task Force's Force Point total decreases by 5% each day at midnight Greenwich Mean Time.
For example, if your Task Force has 200 Force Points, it will lose 10 Force Points at the end of the day. So keep collecting those Force Points to stay high on the Leaderboard.

The number of Force Points that the Task Force wins after an Operation is a factor in determining how good the Operation Reward that people in the Task Force receive is. More Force Points means a greater reward. Read more here.
Note that destroying every power base does not instantly end the Operation. You do not get the Force Points until the Operation ends.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Force Points are similar to Victory Points in the sense that both determine ranks on Leaderboards, but Victory Points are for single player and Force Points are for multiplayer.
The maximum amount of Force Points that a team can currently have is 43,200. This is due to the maximum take of 2,160 Force Points per day, but also losing 5% of the total per day.

However, this can be circumvented by starting a second operation in a day, considering each operation lasts 23 hours and 55 minutes, effectively allowing Task Forces to reach 45,360 points for up to 5 minutes.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: The Power Core can only be found on Power Bases during Operations and on the final Stage of Blitz, and serves as their equivalent to the Headquarters. Destroying all Power Cores on a base will destroy all other buildings.
Usually, each Base only has one Power Core. Exceptions include Operation Duplexity (multiple bases with two Cores) and Blitz (three Cores on the final stage).
The HQ Damage Rule applies to all Power Cores simultaneously. If any other building is destroyed, all Power Cores lose a small percentage of their maximum health, up to 70%.

Shield Generators connected to multiple Power Cores will take damage equivalent to their maximum health divided by the number of Power Cores when one of the shields have been destroyed. Destroying the Shield Generator itself will remove all Shields supplied to any applicable Power Cores.
Due to its 7x7 dimensions, one Smoke Screen or Medkit cannot cover it. As such, Smokey Warrior Rush strategies are much less effective.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Power Core has no levels. Its base health is always the same, so Ice Statues and Shield Generators are the only things that increase the health of the Core.
If the last Power Core is destroyed by the death of a Scorcher, it will be demolished, but any other remaining buildings will not, leaving the base incomplete.
In an old Tutorial the Player attack an Operation Base with three Power Cores in total.

Similar to Engine Rooms, the Power Core grants 5 Gunboat Energy when destroyed, increasing by 5 for each additional Power Core destroyed. These effects can both be observed if the base has at least three Power Cores.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Statues are created from the Sculptor. Power Stones are required to create statues. For information regarding the odds of getting Power Stones from attacks, click here.
When a Statue is created, you can do one of three things with the Statue:
Deploy the Statue on your base if you still have available slots.
Salvage the Statue to destroy it immediately and get one Power Stone of the next rank. Upon destruction of a masterpiece, seven units of Power Powder will be rewarded instead.
Store the Statue to place it in the Statue Storage, unlocked at Headquarters level thirteen.
Statues come in 4 different elements: Life, Ice, Magma, and Dark.
Statues boost different aspects of the game, such as increasing building health or increasing Wood production rate.
Life Statues boost resource production by both increasing the production rate and the storage capacity of your Resource Production buildings by the corresponding percentage.
This bonus also applies to your Resource Bases.
Ice Statues boost your buildings health or damage output.
Defensive building damage statues do not increase mine damage.
These boosts also affect all of the structures of your Resource Bases.
Magma Statues boost your troops by either increasing their health or damage output.
Dark Statues may boost Power Stone chance, initial Gunboat energy, and resource rewards from raids.

text.title: Какие бывают статуи
lines: A statue's percentage is random. You cannot influence it in any way.
If you already have one type of statue, you can still get another statue of the same type.
The statues that you have made in the past and your stats also have no effect on what statues you will get in the future.
Higher percentages are rarer than lower percentages, so it may take several attempts to get a more powerful statue.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Some of the debris found on Lt. Hammerman's bases are suggested, by dialogue, to be statues that the Blackguard have smashed.
There's an achievement which is called Perfectionist that gives a total of 60 diamonds upon salvaging a total of 3,000 Statues.
Statue boosts can last for a maximum of 100 days, costing 300 Power Powder.
In 2013, you could have as many Masterpieces as you wanted. This changed on 30 December 2013, when Ice, Magma, and Dark Power Stones were also added.
Originally, creating an Idol took 1 hour, a Guardian took 4 hours, and a Masterpiece took 12 hours. These times were reduced on 17 June 2014.
Power Stone Chance Statues start with Life Shards, then switch to Magma, Dark and Ice Shards, before returning to Life Shards.
If you tap anywhere else after tapping on a Power Stone Chance Statue, it will always switch back to Life Shards.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Power Stones are used to make Statues.
There are 4 types of Power Stones: Life, Ice, Magma, and Dark.
There are 3 sizes of Power Stones: Fragment, Shard, and Crystal.

It is possible to obtain Power Stones and keep them before you have built the Sculptor, however those that are will only be obtainable through the Daily Reward and Supply Chests. Any Power Stones you earn are stored on your base. You will not be able to see how many Power Stones you have until the Sculptor is built, nor are they usable until then.
Power Stones are always safe from enemy raids. Any won during an attack are freshly generated as part of the attacker's loot bonus.
Shards are needed to research Engravings starting with Headquarters 27.
The Limit Cap is 99,999 of each Power Stone.

text.title: Интересное
lines: The limit on the amount of each size of each type of Power Stone one player can have is 9 million, which means you never have to worry about running out of space for more Power Stones because it is virtually impossible to reach this limit.

Power Stones gained from diving typically match the region the dive spot is found in, i.e. Ice Power Stones being found in the ice region, but any Power Stone could potenially be found anywhere in the Archipelago.

text.title: Коротко
lines: In attacks, players use their forces to attempt to destroy an enemy base.
Attacks are started from the Archipelago map and cost Gold to start. (See Experience for details on gold costs at various levels.)
Troops, Squad Leaders, Heroes and Gunboat Weapons are used to destroy the enemy base.

The overall objective in an attack is to destroy the enemy's main building (Headquarters in most cases, Outpost in the case of Resource Bases, Power Core in the case of Operation power bases, Mega Core in the case of Mega Crab stages and Engine Rooms in the case of Warships).
Winning an attack can award Resources, Victory Points, Power Stones, Intel and Prototype Modules.

text.title: Атака
lines: The overall objective in an attack is to destroy the enemy's main building (Headquarters, Outpost, Power Core, Mega Core or Engine Rooms). This is the only way to win any rewards from the attack, or in the case of a Resource Base to capture it for yourself.
Exceptions are Power Bases and Colonel Gearheart's War Factory, where you can earn partial rewards for destroying part of an enemy base.

The base must be destroyed in one attack. If the attack fails, any damage dealt will not be carried over in subsequent attempts. Exceptions include Imitation Game, Power Bases, War Factory, and Mega Crab/Mega Turtle, where they persist until the base' total destruction.
Each Gunboat weapon, Hero Ability and Squad Leader Ability costs a certain amount of energy. All of them have a set increment specific to that ability that occurs per use.
The amount of energy you start with at the beginning of an attack is determined by your Gunboat level and Gunboat Energy Statues.
These can be increased if a Tribe or the Mega Crab / Mega Turtle has a Gunboat Energy boost.
For each building that is destroyed during the attack, you will receive 3 Gunboat Energy immediately, and the types of Gunboat weapons you can newly afford will flash for a hint.
Destroying an Engine Room grants you more Gunboat Energy, and the amount increases with each Engine Room destroyed during the match. To see the full increase, click here.

If you use the Engraving Power Surge, you will receive more than 3 Gunboat Energy, depending on the level of that Engraving. The same applies to the Engraving Grounding, which decreases the amount of Gunboat Energy you receive.
Gunboat Weapons are used to support your troops so that they are able to reach the Headquarters and destroy it.
After being fired, each Gunboat weapon will take some time to reach its destination depending on how far that destination is from the Gunboat so it is important to time your Weapon launch.
Gunboat Abilities such as Artillery, Barrages, Shock Bombs, Cryobombs and Speed Serum will affect troops as well as buildings, so be careful where you fire them.
Artillery, Barrage and Cryobomb will damage troops that they hit, but their splash damage also makes them useful against groups of buildings.
Shock Bombs will prevent troops that they hit from moving and attacking.

text.title: Коротко
lines: A Defense is when a player's home base or resource base is attacked by another player's forces.
To successfully defend your base, the player's Headquarters or the Resource Base's Outpost must survive the attack.
This can be accomplished in two ways: Destroying enough Troops to prevent them from finishing the attack before the timer expires, if at all, or force them to retreat.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Originally there was no limit to the amount of Diamonds a player could drop. The treshold of 20 Diamonds after which follow up attacks can no longer drop Diamonds was introduced in a later moment, to prevent exploits where players purposedly drop enormous amounts of Diamonds to each others.

Players who have not built a Vault will always lose 100% of their resources, unless they have reached at least Headquarters level 28, which allows the Engraving Insurance to protect part of their resources.
Insurance does not affect the amount of resources earned by the attacker, it will refund the defender with resources "generated from thin air".
If your Task Force is already at 2300 Intel, Intel generated in any way will not increase the amount of Intel you have provided to the Task Force.

It is still possible to lose a defense if the attacker is retreating, but any sort of Damage Over Time, Artillery, Barrage, collateral damage, or Death Damage destroys the Headquarters before the retreat has been completed.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Victory Points, in general, is the basis of the game's Matchmaking and Leaderboards. It also influences the player's Rank, which in turn determines the quality and quantity of Daily Rewards, as well as Supply Chests.
An achievement called War Hero is awarded for reaching specific Victory Point milestones.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Blitz is a limited-time event where you attack Warships and Operation-like Bases for Pass Points.
Blitz is unlocked at Headquarters Level 7.
Blitz can be found on the Archipelago.

Each Blitz Run consists of 10 Bases, each with 3 difficulties: Easy, Medium, and Hard. Depending on the difficulty, the Blitz Engine Room will have a different appearance, and more Buildings are placed on the Map. Harder difficulties may also have more Blitz Engine Rooms to destroy.
Stage 10 always takes place on an Operation-like Base where you have to destroy 3 Power Cores, regardless of the Difficulty.
Clearing a Stage gives you Pass Points, which are necessary to make progress in the Blitz Pass.

On Easy, you obtain 10, on Medium 15, and on Hard 25 Pass Points. Completing Harder difficulties will not give you the Pass Points of the easier difficulties, you have to complete all difficulties to gain all the Pass Points.
Clearing a Stage on Hard difficulty additionally gives you leaderboard points.
The Score is based on whether you used a Mercenary, how many attempts are left, and how much time you needed.
The Layout for Stages is always the same for this Event. Each Event will have different Layouts.
You have a set number of attempts for each Stage. If you fail all of them, you have to use a Reset Token. On Easy, you have 10 attempts, on Medium 7, and on Hard 5.
You do not need Reset Tokens for Easy or Medium difficulties.
Each day other than the 1st you can reset each stage one time without consuming a Reset Token.
For the first 7 Days, you will receive a Daily Supply each Day consisting of 3 Mercenary Contracts and 3 Reset Tokens .

text.title: Интересное
lines: It is possible to beat every Stage except Stage 9 using only Sgt. Antti Pylkäs' Squad on Difficulty Easy, within the 10-Attack limit per Stage.
A bug allowed some players to play the 1st Blitz event early, until a hotfix made Blitz unavailable for everyone.
The starting date was also adjusted a couple times to fix "unknown bugs".

Despite everything, and 2 mainteinances on the 1st day of the event, it is sometimes possible to have a desync error while starting an attack. This forces the game to restart, but it does not consume an attack. Attacking again will usually work normally without further errors.
Rocket Launchers on Stage 10 Hard Difficulty appear to have a bugged attack range.
Mines with increased range will show their trigger range, not the range of the explosion. Also only the explosion range is affected by Stage modifier, the trigger range isn't.
The Increased Range modifier has no effect on blind spots. Defenses with blind spots will not have larger or smaller blind spots if affected by range modifiers.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Warships is the secondary game mode of Boom Beach.
It is unlocked either at Headquarters level 10 or through the purchase of the Boom Pass.

In Warships, players participate in real-time battles against each other and earn rewards by ranking up. Its progression is not shared with the Home Island. Instead, any made in each season are automatically reset in the next.
There are many key features of Warships. Players will need strategic upgrade planning, good attacking skills and good base building skills to succeed.

Warship Seasons currently form a special event cycle with Mega Crab events: Warship Season (21 or 28 days)→4 days without events→Mega Crab event (3 days). Each such cycle lasts 28 or 35 days, similar to other Supercell games.
Certain Seasons like S56-S59 or S70 lasted for 7 days
The first 4 Seasons also lasted at least a month with S3 being the longest with 88 days.
Season 4 was planned to last 95 days, but it was first delayed and then reduced to 45 days.

lines: The Mega Crab is a special event that involves Dr. T and his super weapon.
The Mega Crab is available for players at Headquarters level 7 or above.
The Mega Crab is a large base with infinite stages on top of a large, purple, mechanical crab near the player's home base.

It is not a part of the regular Event Cycle. The Mega Crab appears mostly once per month, starting at 08:00 UTC, usually on the last Friday of the month, and ending on 08:00 UTC the following Monday, lasting 72 hours. Loading Screen during Mega Crab Event
During Mega Crab the Loading Screen temporarily changes.

There are 14 total crab themes: Lunar New Year Crab, Cryo Crab, Anniversary Crab, Hasty Crab, Tribal Crab, Life Leech Crab, Scorched Crab, Gunboat Crab, Beastly Crab, Halloween Crab (formerly known as Hallowed Crab), Proto Crab, New Year Crab, Joker Crab and Piggy Crab (removed).

text.title: Интересное
lines: The Imitation Game and the Attackable Statue Mega Crab are currently the only instances in the game where the limit of one Masterpiece per power type can be broken. This happens because the Imitation Game copies bases from real players, and adds 2 Ice Masterpieces on top of the already existing statues. This may result in 2 Defense Damage Masterpieces and/or 2 Building Health Masterpieces.

The only other instance where that limit could be broken was before the global launch of the game, where players were allowed unlimited Masterpieces for the same power (within the maximum allowed by the Sculptor).

The Imitation Game and particularly the Attackable Statue Mega Crab are also the only events where there can be more than 13 statues in the map, the maximum allowed for HQ28 players who leveled up the Sculptor to level 11.

The Imitation Game is the only event that always allows the existence of Bunkers, if the Headquarters are at least level 26. Because Bunkers are copied from real players, it is possible for them to be empty. As they are copied from the main base, they will only ever be filled with regular troops, if they are filled at all.
Troops from bunkers are still limited to the power granted by the replicated player's own Magma Statues, as only Ice statues are added to the copied base.
Before the October Update, the lowest possible Statue percentage was significantly lower than it is today.

At high Threat Levels, existing bases will repeat 1 level lower than they were the previous week (for example the level 50 base will appear again at level 49). This means that as long as the previous event was completed, there will be 2 new configuration as the final levels of the event, while the 2 lowest configurations of the previous week won't appear. All other configurations will appear again with 10% less Building Damage and 30% less Building Health.
The Imitation Game and Warships are the only events that allow bases to have Sky Shields. Mega Crabs and other Cycle of Evil events will never have it.
The Headquarters level for the Imitation Game and the War Factory is capped at 27.

The "Lowest Building Health statue" and "Lowest Building Damage statue" values in the section below refers to what will be the total Building Health and total Building Damage values will be in the case the original player base has statues weaker than that value. If the values of the player's statues exceed the minimum, no changes will be done, if it doesn't, a Masterpiece will be added to match exactly the minimum value while taking the copied player's statues into consideration.

For example, if at Threat Level 30 a player has 110% Building Health and 110% Building Damage, a Building Health Masterpiece with 10% Health bonus will be spawned, as 110% is less than the 120% minimum Building Health bonus for that stage, but no Building Damage Masterpiece will be spawned as the Damage bonus exceeds the minimum value of 50%.

If the copied player's statues were lit at the moment they were copied, the statue bonuses will remain completely unaffected, as they always show the boost percentage as if they were in their base state.

Originally only 66 Threat Levels were programmed into the game, but this was changed to 99 in the Gadgets & Squad Leaders update as many players were rapidly approaching the highest difficulty levels. Threat 99 will have 2190% Building Health and 640% Building Damage.

lines: Boss Bases are bases controlled by high ranked Blackguard members that appear in the Archipelago.
Only 3 Characters are controlling Boss Bases: Lt. Hammerman, Dr. T and Colonel Gearheart
There only exist 11 Boss Bases. Each boss base only exists once. Once destroyed, they never respawn.
Boss bases give the Player a guaranteed amount of life, magma, or ice Power Stones (depending on the the island's terrain) as well as a high amount of Resources, and always 5 Victory Points.
If you are in a Task Force, they also have a 25% chance of awarding one piece of Intel.
If you have built the Weapon Lab, they also have an 8% chance to award a Prototype Module.
Boss Bases do not follow the rules of a player base. For example: one Boss Base has 16 Cannons while the most a player can have is six.

Cpt. Everspark can be unlocked after beating War Factory.

text.title: Как обороняться
lines: General insight is the player's best chance at surviving a wave. When toggling Hammerman's Gunboat to initiate an attack, be sure to preview the Troops he plans to bring along with him, and their order from left to right.

Troops that are dropped off first can be planned for, such if Hammerman chooses to load off an entire wave of Zookas first, it would be best to place splash damage defenses such as Rocket Launchers and Mortars so their range intersects with the beach.

Rifleman swarming is a pretty popular tactic of Hammerman's, and it is very difficult to deal with, especially when Medics are a part of the equation. Wherever one plans to eliminate hoards of Riflemen altogether, place a neat and organized row of Mines in their path. The multiple continuous strikes are not likely to be healed before the Riflemen die.
Hot Pots are extremely effective as their great damage per second will easily counter any Medics' healing, and eliminate large amounts of Riflemen within seconds.

If Hammerman decides to deploy a wave of Grenadiers ahead of all other combinations, it is best to throw every Boom Cannon and a Shock Launcher, coupled with a few Sniper Towers at the beach head. If the player feels the next wave will be a hoard of Riflemen, plop these long range defenses nine to eleven tiles away from the shore and place Boom Mines at the head of the beach instead.

Notice: Shock Launchers should never cover the beach when a hoard of Riflemen are expected to be brought first. If a hoard of Riflemen survive before the next wave lands, the next wave will receive those shocked Rifles as their cover. The only exception is if Rocket Launchers attack the first wave of Riflemen in unison with the Shock Launcher and no Medics are present.
A Shock Blaster is extremely effective at dealing with Grenadiers. Their high damage per second, combined with their long range, can easily shut down a wave of Grenadiers.
Take advantage of Hammerman's AI. If you spy him Barraging a defense of your's down, put it off to the side in the next attack and rid any mines away from its proximity.

One could take advantage of this knowledge and place it in a position where it is likely Hammerman will use his GBE on it when his Troops pass around the targeted building. This is especially useful when clearing an unstoppable swarm of Riflemen.

In the case of a Warrior rush right off the bat, sacrifice any economy building (usually one to three for the lower stages) in their path. If Riflemen do not follow, place regular Mines around the front of the bait buildings. Warriors should not make it to the second line.

To take advantage of any strategy of Hammerman's, maximize the amount of time it takes him to clear all of your buildings and start aiming for the Headquarters. This is made easier to the player due to the fact that Lt. Hammerman does not use Flares.

This can be done with a variety of base layouts, but is particularly attainable with any variant of a sweep base, where all buildings create a wrap around the side of the base, follow to the rear of the island, and cycle back to the other side.

Notable features include a front line that begins at the shore of Hammerman's first chosen landing side on the beach and long range defenses such as Rocket Launchers and various Prototype Defenses placed in the center of the island.

If you have attempted to defend Hammerman and failed, but know that a lot of Riflemen were left at the end of the attack, you could place a line of Mines at the back, behind most of your defenses but in front of the HQ. Be sure to redirect the remaining Riflemen in a manner such that they would move to the next building in the formation of a line to maximize the effectiveness of this strategy.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Blackguard bases are bases controlled by the Blackguard that appear regularly in the Archipelago.
Like Mercenary bases, Blackguard Bases appear in random locations around your Archipelago.
The fewer Blackguard bases you have on your Archipelago, the more likely it is that more will appear. Read more about Invasions.
Most Blackguard bases are designed by Supercell themselves, however there are many other Blackguard bases designed by players through the Blackguard Base Builder.

Blackguard bases that are designed by players will have a pair of hammers above the red circle denoting the base's experience level. When scouting such a base, the name of the designer of the base will appear in the top-left corner.
Destroying a player-created Blackguard base generally yields 10% more resource rewards than a Blackguard base created by Supercell.
These bases give decent amounts of life, magma, and ice Power Stones (depending on the the island's terrain), Resources, and 1-2 Victory Points.
If you are in a Task Force, they also have a 25% chance of awarding one piece of Intel.
If you have built the Weapon Lab, they also have an 8% chance to award a Prototype Module.

Each Blackguard base has its own setup of Defensive Buildings and, sometimes, some Support Buildings. Although, many of them do have Supply Buildings. These are good for easily replenishing Gunboat energy.
The Defensive Buildings do not follow the rules of a player base. For example: some bases have 10 Boom Cannons while the most a player can have is six.
Each base has a specific layout, but the levels of defenses can vary.
This also affects that base's XP level.
Some variations of a base may even have Mines or Boom Mines while other variations do not.

text.title: Коротко
lines: These bases are other players' home base, so unlike Blackguard Bases, they have restrictions on what kind and how many Defensive Buildings they can have.
The Loot available varies by how many Resources the player's Vault did not protect at the time you discovered their base.
Once a village has been scouted, you can see the Resource rewards without having to Scout again, the only result of scouting an island.

The amount of loot available on a base will not change while it is on your Map, but a player's base design can. As time goes on, players on your map may increase in level by constructing or upgrading existing buildings. This is due to the Victory Point based Matchmaking system.
In addition, Mercenary resource rewards are subject to Loot Bonuses.

Like one's own base, Mercenaries can feature all of the possible buildings that he has, however, support buildings will be tinted red to reflect their allegiance to the Blackguard. These buildings include the Residencies, Radar, Landing Crafts, Gunboat, Armory, and Headquarters.
They are not guaranteed to be accessible to attack at your wish. Due to Boom Beach’s safeguarding features, players can be online for a maximum of four hours without being at risk of being attacked.
Any player who does try to attack the base while their target is online will be greeted by the message, "Can't Attack! Island owner is online."
Unlike Blackguard Bases, Mercenary Bases cannot be destroyed by a Tribe's militia.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Several Achievements in the game are directly tied to the defeat or defense from Mercenaries, such as Conqueror, Strategist, and Steamroller.
As well, there are Achievements involving the seizure of resources and Victory Point gain, such as War Hero and Spoils of War to Iron Will.

When attacking a Mercenary's base, offensive structures will disappear from the docks. This is most likely the case because it would be awkward for one’s troops to sit and watch their base get destroyed from the sidelines.

When scouting Mercenary bases, another player’s builders will appear in Blackguard uniform, however they will act the same as normal builders and run inside the Headquarters when their base is attacked.

Defeating a Mercenary Base owned by a player ranked 3rd or higher globally will award a bounty in the form of guaranteed Crystals. Defeating the top global player will result in a default 3 crystal reward, 2 for the runner up, and 1 from the third highest ranking.
Once you have opened clouds on the Map containing your first Mercenary Base, you have given the game the opportunity to include your base to be matched with other players and attacked.
Defeating a Mercenary Base yields a higher chance of gaining Intel, set at 50%.
The islands on which Mercenary Bases are placed on are unique from normal islands as the island will feature a dock at which players house their Landing Crafts.
Blackguard Bases can appear on Mercenary style bases by rare chance, however a Mercenary base will never invade an island that does not have an open dock on its lower-right side.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Resource Bases are additional bases that are independent of your home base and are scattered throughout the Archipelago. They become available after reaching Headquarters Level 3.

Once you uncover one in the Archipelago, you can attack it and destroy it. Once destroyed, you gain ownership of it. Other players can do this too, so you may have to re-conquer a Resource Base whenever it is taken over by other players.
If you own a Resource Base, you do have the ability to adjust the placement of its buildings, just as you would on your own base.
Resource Bases that you control will be affected by any Ice Statues you have on your home island. Any boosts on these Statues will also take effect. Tribe bonuses will work as well.
Every time a Resource Base is taken over, existing Defensive Buildings are upgraded and new Defensive Buildings can appear unless both are not available.
Shock Launchers, Bunkers, Garrisons, Prototype Defenses, Boom Mines, and Shock Mines will never appear on Resource Bases.
The Amount of Mines will never be increased.

The Resource production structure will never be upgraded. Each Resource Base island has a fixed production building level from 2 to 8. To get a resource base with a higher level collector building, you will have to conquer a resource base that is farther away from your home base.

They provide you with shipments of Wood, Stone or Iron (depending on the kind of resource base you have) directly to your island. These shipments can be collected from the Resource Boat that appears just south of your docks.
The first Wood Resource Base can be found with a level 3 Radar.
The first Stone Resource Base can be found with a level 6 Radar.
The first Iron Resource Base can be found with a level 9 Radar.

text.title: Интересное
lines: You can clear Obstacles on your Resource Bases, such as trees and stones. The Obstacles that are cleared never respawn, even if they are cleared by an opponent when they hold the base.
Occasionally, you will come across a Resource Base that, instead of being called
"(Player's name)'s Resource Base", is simply called "Resource Base". This is a new Resource Base freshly generated by the game, typically with a low-leveled Outpost.
You can have up to a maximum of 14 Wood, Stone, and Iron bases. The production per hour by conquering all Resource Bases of one type is 15,140.
Gold is the only resource to lack its respective base, as Freed Villages provide them.
If a Resource Base does not have any more space to add new defenses and all present defenses are maxed, nothing will happen if it is conquered.
Resource Bases not yet discovered are teased through the clouds. If tapped, a message will appear saying, "This region has a resource base".

Resource Bases will never yield Power Stones, Prototype Modules, Intel, or Resources that it does not produce when conquered. They only give the resource it produces. This means that gold will always be lost in an attack, even if you win with no casualties due to the attack cost.
With the Engraving Alchemy it is possible to earn a other Resource that is not produced by this Resource Base.
If you defend a Resource Base, you will not get any Diamonds or Intel from it, even if enough troops are destroyed.
Pressing the base's icon on your Map will reveal the production rate of its resource type.
The lowest possible Experience level of a resource base is level three.
There's an achievement which is called War Production that gives a total of 90 diamonds upon controlling a total of 35 Resource Bases (out of the possible 42).
Between the 24th of June and the 21th of October 2015, a bug made it possible to create multiple layouts for the Resource Base.

text.title: Общая информация
lines: Barbed Wire is an invulnerable defensive structure that can appear on high-end Operations.
Any troops walking in Barbed Wire will have their movement speed reduced by 75% and slowly lose health.
Barbed Wire has a base damage per second value of 80, and can be increased by Ice Statues.
Barbed Wire only deals damage while the troop is moving. If the troop does not move, it will not receive damage.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: When possible, find different routes that avoid barbed wire when using highly vulnerable troops, such as Zookas.
If you have to go through the Barbed Wire, consider using higher-health Troops, accounting for the damage they will be dealt while passing through the wires.

If there is only a single row of fencing in a select area that must be crossed to carry on an attack, place Medkits on the Barbed Wire as Troops pass through. Examine the heal per second of your Medkit and ensure you have enough Gunboat energy before attempting, as having a net loss could result in a failed attack.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Barbed Wire typically only appears in the highest level Operations (Deep Cut and above), but it formerly appeared in the base named "Strange Attractors" all the way down to the Mambo Operation before being removed from such bases.
The real-world barbed wire was invented by Michael Kelly in 1868 but was improved significantly by Joseph F. Glidden who received a patent for the modern version of it in 1874.
It is the only damaging building that cannot be destroyed.
Troops that come in contact with the Barbed Wire will turn a bluish tint until they cease taking damage from the fence.
After the Critter Launcher & Laser Ranger update, several posts were spotted in resource bases and low end operations.
Besides Operations the Barbed Wire also appears on Hammerman HQ 8 as well as the Tutorial Base.
Before 20 March 2017, Barbed Wire could be shocked, preventing it from damaging troops or reducing their movement speed while affected.
Between March 2018 and March 2026, Barbed Wire dealt significantly less damage than intended due to a bug.

text.title: Коротко
lines: Second Wind is a Hero Ability available for Dr. Kavan starting at level 3.
Second Wind revives defeated Troops, spawning them near Dr.Kavan.
NPC Units are not subject to Second Wind.
Zookas and Heavies spawned by Rocket Choppas and Heavy Choppas are also affected.

Revived troops will glow purple, and do not register as additional troops. They behave similar to the original, carrying the same stats & behavior (Scorchers, for example, will still run around erratically and skim over targets, blowing up if destroyed), will obey Flares, and can even be healed.
Much like Critters, revived troops will stand still during retreats. They persist until the battle ends, or if they are destroyed, being lost permanently upon the attack's conclusion.

Second Wind prioritizes reviving recent casualties, and will not resurrect the same unit more than once. For example, if two Heavies and two Zookas are defeated in that order and the ability is used at level 1, Dr. Kavan will revive two Zookas and one Heavy.
Second Wind only revives a certain amount of valid troops based on its own and their capacity, and will spawn Riflemen to fill up any remaining space.
Any troops spawned by Second Wind do not count toward casualties when destroyed.
Each use costs 10 more Energy than the previous one, with a starting cost of 8 Energy.

text.title: Как атаковать
lines: Using the Second Wind ability to start a battle with extra Riflemen can bolster your army for the entirety of the attack, especially if your army already includes Riflemen and the ability was sufficiently upgraded.
In the event of a retreat, Second Wind could be used to revive fallen troops who will stand around distracting turrets while your main forces escape.

In the event you lose an important troop in your attack, such as a Medic, you should activate the ability as soon as possible before others could take its place. This matters more the larger it is, such as Scorchers, Tanks, Grenadiers and the aforementioned Medic.

text.title: Интересное
lines: Although both have the same duration and revive capacity, a level 6 Second Wind requires 0.001 seconds less time between revives than a level 19 Remote Defib.
Second Wind used to be able to revive fallen troops from defending Bunkers, but the interaction has been removed shortly after discovery.
Second Wind used to be able to resurrect the same unit more than once, but was later limited to just one use.
When units could be resurrected multiple times, the same unit could be cycled multiple times between Second Wind and Mind Control.

The speed at Kavan does his animation is affected by speed modifiers like Rally, Adrenaline and Speed Serum, but the speed at which troops are actually summoned is fixed by Second Wind's level. Kavan will however be able to move before the last unit is summoned if his speed is high enough.

If Kavan is has just recently landed on the coast and is walking towards his checkpoint, he'll be able to walk while summoning troops with Second Wind. If the ability is used multiple times in quick succession, at the end of the first animation he'll slide instead.
Kavan will freeze in place at the end of the 1st ability use if in the meantime the ability has been used again.
Second Wind will still keep summoning troops is Kavan is stunned by any means mid usage, but not if he's KO'd.
Before 15 September 2026, Second Wind could not revive Rocket Choppas, Heavy Choppas or Seekers.
